method: EEDI reference lines (MEPC.203(62), bulk row amended MEPC 75) for size scaling; per-family calibration to observed operating consumption; newbuild prices from dated broker tables and reported contracts; OPEX from Moore Maritime Index 2025 (FY2024 audited accounts, EXCLUDING drydock/special survey).

speedLaw.note: Power ~ v^3 so GJ/day ~ v^3; nm/day ~ v so GJ/nm ~ v^2. Apply 2.0 to the per-nm figures in energy{}. Applying 3.0 to a per-nm quantity understates by 12% at 11.5 vs 13 kn and 23% at 10 kn.
